_comment: Movable/lunisolar NSE trading holidays only (Holi, Ram Navami, Eid, Ganesh Chaturthi, Dussehra, Diwali, Guru Nanak Jayanti, Good Friday, etc.) -- fixed-date national holidays (Republic Day, Maharashtra Day, Independence Day, Gandhi Jayanti, Christmas) are generated in code (src/data/nse_calendar.py) and do not need to be listed here. This file is a best-effort reference seeded from NSE's publicly announced 2025 trading-holiday circular; it is NOT re-verified against a live NSE source by this codebase and must be reviewed/updated by an operator at least once a year against NSE's actual published circular before being treated as authoritative beyond development and testing -- see src/data/nse_calendar.py's module docstring for why exact dates are not fabricated in code for years without a verified circular.
